description: Defines interfaces and structures for the auto-hinter module in the FreeType project, including functions for retrieving, resetting, and loading glyph hints, as well as the auto-hinter service interface.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalGetFunc
methods.description: Retrieves global hints for a face, returning a typeless pointer and its size.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalResetFunc
methods.description: Recomputes global font metrics, useful when font data changes.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlyphLoadFunc
methods.description: Loads, scales, and hints a glyph from a face.
